propositions: Four core modules (applier, fetcher, apply_handlers, _attestation) import adapters.jira for scalar concerns that should route through neutral Backend protocol
Backend Protocol lacks scalar read-only members (project, query_project) and env-readiness contract (assert_env_ready) needed to eliminate vendor-specific imports
JiraBackend and other Backend implementors must support project scoping with DIG default semantics, un-defaulted query variants, and environment validation without exposing vendor-shaped interfaces
Nested function-level imports of adapters.jira within the four modules require full-tree AST analysis (ast.walk) rather than top-level-only inspection to verify neutrality
AssigneeNotFoundError and env validation errors must be raised through neutral base exceptions defined on Backend protocol so callers remain vendor-agnostic
